evidence_kind: native Isaac Sim visual-servo and supervised-imitation autonomous evaluation

model.method: Visual servo with continuous physical hold and windowed RGB confirmation; trained normalized cup model and contextual motion; bounded full feedback and calibrated slow empty confirmation

localization_validation.method: Supervised gradient-template localization, CUDA normalized correlation and subpixel refinement

model.controller_revision_note: Predicted-window neck tracking, calibrated low-contrast score floor.23, 12px tolerance, and measured TCP rise>35mm; both encoder fingers must show obstruction. No learned weights or trajectories changed after successful early-full development.

full_calibration.basis: Consumed overflow regression showed the .96 prediction target was unreachable: at physical height .971 the CNN was .944, and repeated trim overflowed. Use reachable .94 target after 1.2s settling; cap trim at95deg and .1s after reaching94.5deg, with at most two micro-topups. Physical >=90% scoring stays unchanged. All failed/aborted development retained.

vote_calibration.method: Controller-only temporal and confidence calibration on consumed G_A records
vote_calibration.selection: Lowest slow confidence with zero observed premature cap latches, correct target detection within2s, and >=80% bilateral contact until call;24votes plus physical/cap/flow gates. Support is limited; new native tests are required.

pour_primitive.method: Contextual movement primitive, own lift joints plus visual cup XY; CUDA ridge imitation

grasp_closure.method: Half the first percentile of observed opposing-finger closure deficits in verified expert holds

selection.selection_reason: New visual/proprioceptive grasp gate and settled-level fill feedback, selected using development only; all prior failed/aborted development retained.
selection.test_policy: Run six new seed20261126 cases once; no model/config/controller/physics changes, no expert fallback during the block.
selection.deadline_note: 40 simulated seconds and 12-second grasp deadline allow one retry and settled top-up cycles; success criteria and accepted physics unchanged.

primary_goal: verified sustained grasp, height>=90%rim OR source<=max(.25 nominal mL,1% initially), correct reason, completed upright set-down/release, zero measured outside/below-worktop particles
legacy_goal: Original inventory>=90% plus original physical/completion gates; retained unchanged
volume_units: nominal particle count volume; not calibrated mL
